stages.title: Play the story
stages.summary: Play through Chapters 1 to 5 in order while keeping manual saves at the start and end of each chapter since mission replay is unavailable. Make sure to perform the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude early, and scan vehicles, study animals, and take optional missions as they appear.
trophy_names: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
stages.tip: Never use cheats as they disable both trophy progression and saving.

stages.title: The 100% Completion checklist
stages.summary: After completing the story, access the 100% Completion tracker under Progress and Stats to methodically work through remaining requirements. Complete 100 optional missions, scan 200 vehicles, study 100 animals, finish 300 stunts, beat 70 challenges, clear all robberies and bank vaults, and finish gang operations, Target Decks, and meditations.
stages.tip: Nothing in the 100% checklist is missable, so take your time exploring Leonida.

stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
stages.summary: Wrap up all eight stranger character questlines and mop up any remaining miscellaneous trophies across the map. Conclude your journey by finishing final activities and resolving final open collectibles.
stages.tip: Double-check your missable tracking for Positive Mental Attitude before endgame.
